full_judgment:
31. The dead body of the victim Nazrul Islam was taken to his village home at Torbona under Shibgonj Police Station in the district of Chapai Nawabgonj and his dead body was buried there on 7-4-2003 at 11-00 AM. 

 32. After the recording of the confessional statements of the accused persons, the real facts were disclosed, then the dead body of the victim Nazrul Islam was disinterred observing all legal formalities on 14-6-2003 i.e. after 37 days and the dead body was sent to the morgue of Chapai Nawabgonj General Hospital. A board was formed consisting of five members who sent the viscera for chemical examination and after getting the viscera report, they opined that the causes of death could not be detected as the dead body was sent to the morgue of Chapai Nawabgonj General Hospital. A board was formed consisting of five members who sent the viscera for chemical examination and after getting viscera report, they opined that the causes of death could not be detected as the dead body was highly decomposed. 

 58. It is stated in the case of Nawab vs State reported in 17 DLR (SC) 489 that when at the time of confession, some incriminating articles are found then such evidence support the confessional statements. In the instant case, seizing of such articles which were used for the purpose of killing the victim Nazrul Islam clearly supports the confessional statements of the accused Nazmul and Rajesh.
